subject: Post-call: QuantEdge latency & topology deep-dive — next steps and pilot plan
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@quantedge.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: QuantEdge latency & topology deep-dive — next steps and pilot plan

Thanks again for the call earlier today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please reply if I missed anything.

Key pain points you shared:
- P95 tail spikes during peak traffic (we heard ~300–400ms) impacting interactive UX.
- Cost pressure on high-volume assist/compose flows — need predictable unit economics.
- Security/compliance checklist: VPC-only egress, SOC2 evidence, retention controls.

Goals you described:
- Achieve p95 latency <= 150ms for typical prompt size (~250 tokens), 95% of the time.
- Support sustained throughput of ~120 req/s with short bursts to 250 req/s.
- Pilot in us-west region with predictable capacity and ops runbook.

Technical notes / constraints from our side:
- Model: you said a finetuned Llama-2-34b variant (custom weights) — need model artifact and tokenizer.
- Context: average 250 tokens, occasional 1024 token requests.
- Security: VPC + KMS; we'll propose Private deployment for the pilot or Dedicated depending on contract.

Proposed pilot topology (high level):
1) Dedicated GPU pool in us-west-2 (2 reserved nodes) for baseline latency SLOs.
2) Autoscale/burst into shared capacity for traffic spikes (policy-based routing).
3) KV/prefix caching for common prompts + continuous batching (target batch size 8–16) to reduce per-token cost.
4) Int8 quantized execution path for the finetuned model to improve throughput; fall back to fp16 variant for quality checks.
5) Tracing hooks and token-level cost telemetry enabled for initial 14-day pilot.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can you send a sample of production traces (requests + end-to-end latencies) and a model artifact or link to the finetuned model by end of week? (attachment stub: "quantedge-traces-20260610.jsonl")
- I'll share a topology sketch and a short cost/ops hypothesis. See attached: "qe-svc-topology-draft.pdf" and call recording.
- Propose a 60-minute technical deep-dive on Fri Jun 12. Availability: 10:00–11:00 PT or 16:00–17:00 UTC — here is a scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood/quantedge-techdeep

Deliverables from Redwood for the pilot:
- Topology diagram + ops runbook
- Initial costing + performance targets (p50/p95/p99 token latency)
- SOC2 onboarding checklist and required artifacts list

Thanks — looking forward to the next call.

—
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: qe-call-recording.mp4 (audio/mp4), qe-svc-topology-draft.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@quantedge.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@quantedge.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: QuantEdge latency & topology deep-dive — next steps and pilot plan

Thanks Markus — this looks right and very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Model details: we're currently serving a finetuned Llama-2-34b (custom tokenizer, package available). We can provide the artifact via a secure S3 link.
- Observed numbers: p95 currently ~300–400ms under peak (burst windows ~10–12 minutes); p99 hits ~900ms occasionally.
- Throughput: baseline steady state ~90–120 req/s; peaks up to ~260 req/s for 2–3 hour daily window. Typical payload ~250 tokens; about 8% of requests exceed 700 tokens.
- Security: VPC peering preferred. SOC2 in progress — we can share the compliance pack for review.
- Retention: session logs must be purged after 30 days; audit logs retained 1 year.

We attached a small sample of traces from a recent peak window (quantedge-traces-20260610.jsonl). We'll also upload the model artifact by EOD Friday.

We'll take the Fri Jun 12 10:00 PT slot if that works for your infra/serving folks. Please include an ops/infra engineer and someone who can speak to the quantization/latency tradeoffs.

—
Ethan Wu
Head of Platform, QuantEdge
ethan.wu@quantedge.ai

Attachment: quantedge-traces-20260610.jsonl (application/jsonl)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@quantedge.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: QuantEdge latency & topology deep-dive — next steps and pilot plan

Great — thanks for the traces and confirm slot. Confirming items we will bring to the Fri deep-dive: 

- Serving/ops proposal: dedicated pool sizing + burst/overflow policy, estimated p95/p99 after int8 quantization and batching.
- Quick A/B plan to validate quality vs int8 quant on a holdout prompt set.
- KV/prefix caching plan and candidate prompt sets where caching yields the highest ROI.
- Required artifacts for Private/Dedicated onboarding (VPC, cert, KMS, retention configs).

Action items for QuantEdge pre-call:
- Upload model artifact + tokenizer link (secure S3) — Ethan
- Share 1–2 high-priority prompt templates to include in our cache candidate set — Laura or Ethan

Internal action items (we'll cover in the internal pre-call):
- Run an initial cost sketch for the pilot (2 reserved nodes + burst).
- Prepare a short benchmark plan we can run against the sample traces (Priyom) — targets: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cost/sec.

I'll attach an updated topology sketch after a quick pass. Attachment: topology-suggestion-v2.png

See you Friday 10:00 PT.

—
Markus

Attachments: topology-suggestion-v2.png (image/png)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: QuantEdge pilot — tasks and owners (post-call)

Markus — quick internal summary and owners so we don't lose momentum. This will live on the deal record (HubSpot QE-2026-047).

Owners / immediate tasks:
- Priyom: run the benchmark harness against the provided traces using Llama-2-34b int8 on our internal perf rig. Deliverable: p50/p95/p99 and cost/sec by EOD Thu (6/18).
- Markus: confirm dedicated pool sizing + draft SOW language for a 30-day pilot (2 reserved nodes + burst).
- Rachel (me): SOC2 onboarding checklist, required artifact list, and a draft retention policy (30-day purge workflow). Deliverable: checklist + next steps doc by Mon 6/15.
- Ops: reserve a staging subnet in us-west-2 and enable token-level tracing for the pilot window (I'll spin this up with infra after the call).

Meeting: Deep-dive scheduled Fri 2026-06-12 10:00 PT (confirmed) — internal pre-call 30 minutes before to align. Attendees: Markus, Priyom, Rachel, Markus' infra lead (TBD), QuantEdge: Ethan, Laura.

Notes: attach topology sketch + call recording to HubSpot. I'll also create the HubSpot task records and link them to QE-2026-047.

—
Rachel Kim
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

CC: hubspot-deal/QE-2026-047, drive:/quantedge/pilot
